Sometimes waiting is the right strategy.

In November 2025, one of the most popular Kubernetes ingress controllers, ingress-nginx, announced its own end. At Nine Kubernetes Engine, over 1,600 ingresses ran on exactly that controller, and our customers asked straight away what was next.

Sebastian Nickel from our platform team shared at TechTalk #29 which alternatives we tried and where they fell short.

What we chose in the end: https://nine.ch/en/blog/techtalk-29-our-ingress-odyssey/
